newsitem.title: USA: Computer Horizons, Price in Year 2000 pact.
newsitem.headline: Computer Horizons, Price in Year 2000 pact.

text.p: Price Waterhouse LLP and Computer Horizons Corp said on Thursday they will work together to market solutions to the Year 2000 problem worldwide.
Computer Horizons will provide technology assessments and tools, and Price Waterhouse will develop business assessments, customized strategies and comprehensive compliance plans.
Code correction and conversion services will come from Computer Horizons while Price Waterhouse provides systems testing and program management, the companies said.

The Year 2000 problem is the need to reprogram computers to recognize that a year ending in 00 is 2000, not 1900. Older software and hardware only recognizes two digits to represent years, which may cause big problems when 1999 turns to 2000.

"Today a large organization typically has millions of lines of code written in multiple languages running on a variety platforms," said Don Caputo, a Price Waterhouse partner, in a news release. "All of the code must be ready to handle Year 2000 date-change issues if the organization is to continue to operate successfully."
